title: Warp hero
description: A window-tall developer hero on a dot grid that fades up from white: a big two-line monospace headline, a muted mono lead, an ink button and an outline button, then a technical figure plate filling the width: a captioned frame around a white card holding an 8 × 28 matrix of tiny status squares (hatched queued, solid blue working, striped waiting, hollow done) with a legend and running totals. Everything rises in on load; the working squares pulse.
notes: the section is as tall as the window and crops the figure at the bottom on short screens, like the original
cell states come from the cells prop or a fixed default pattern; CSS only (no JavaScript)
name: warp-hero

props.name: title
props.description: the big monospace headline (wraps at about 25 characters on desktop)

props.name: secondary
props.description: the outline button (brand-blue outline on phones)

props.name: caption
props.description: caption of the figure frame, e.g. "fig. 1 — the floor"

props.name: figureLabel
props.description: small label at the top left of the figure card

props.name: figureMeta
props.description: small label at the top right of the figure card, e.g. "8 × 28 · live"

props.name: legend
props.description: legend labels for the four cell states

props.name: totals
props.description: the running totals at the bottom right, e.g. ["224 jobs", "41 running"]

props.name: rows
props.description: rows and columns of the matrix

props.name: cells
props.description: each cell's state, row by row; a fixed pattern is used when not given
